title: 第7章  一拳解决问题
content_zh:
一夜很快过去，次日，朝阳升起。
楚弛如约赶往了楚南所在的院落。
还没进院子，他就看见了院子门口的楚盈盈。
楚盈盈看见楚弛，连忙跑了过来，一脸担忧地道。
“七哥，你怎么真的来了！你快回去，你根本不是五哥的对手，要是同他战斗，你肯定会被打断手脚的。这一次，五哥不会手下留情。”
“八妹，你专门在这里等我？但你放心，我不会有事。”
楚弛淡淡一笑，径直走向了院门。
“七哥！你……”
楚盈盈咬住嘴唇，想拦住楚弛，却发现楚弛的身体，像是一座山，根本拦不了。
很快，楚弛进入了偏院。
院子里，不仅有楚南，还有两位女子，两位青年。
分别是楚家晚辈中排行第二的楚枫，排行第四的楚力闻，以及长孙女，楚青荷。
这几人，明显是来看热闹的。
现场除了这几位晚辈，没有任何一位长辈前来观战。
因为所有长辈，都不觉得这场约战有什么悬念，这战斗，提不起他们的兴趣。
“楚弛，你居然来了！我可是赌你不敢来的啊。”
楚枫看见楚弛，当时就皱起了眉头。
楚弛反问道：“我有何不敢来？”
“你的嘴真的挺硬。从小到大，你都是说最硬的话，挨最毒的打。”
“楚弛，这一次挨了打，你不会又哭着回去，找你哥给你出头吧？”

楚力闻和楚枫对着楚弛，一阵嘲讽。
就连楚青荷叶也是一脸鄙夷，他朝楚南开口道：“五弟，昨天他偷袭你那一巴掌，我们都看见了。你不用手下留情，一定要打得他妈都不认识！哦忘了，他从小就没有妈！”
“大姐，你放心吧。要弄他，何其容易？你们等我一会，十个呼吸的时间就行。我去去就来！”
楚南站起身体，朝院子中央的楚弛走了过去。
他昂首挺胸，好似胸有成竹。
“七哥，现在走，还来得及！”
楚盈盈站在楚弛身旁，拉了拉楚弛的衣角。
楚弛微微一笑，道：“放心，我没事。而且，这场架，非打不可！他以前怎么欺负我的，我要他连本带利，还回来！”
楚弛记得很清楚，小时候，他哥哥不在家，楚南总是来找他麻烦。
这世界上，总是有人，喜欢欺负弱者！
他不仅朝楚弛身上吐口水，有一次还趁楚弛不备，将楚弛推进了粪坑。
那滋味，楚弛到现在都没有忘记。
以前，他没有能力，想反击也没办法。
但现在，他有能力了。
他一定要让楚南还回来。
思考间，楚南来到了他的对面，眼神高傲，居高临下。
“楚弛，不得不说，你比小时候有种了。小时候，你可是看见我就躲，根本不敢直视我。
我是真没想到，你一个废物，也能成为修者。但你似乎有些飘，居然敢来挑战我！那我就让你知道，花儿为什么这么红！”
楚弛脸色冷漠地道：“你的话，太多了。要打就打。”
“呵呵，你想早点死，我就成全你。看我一拳，将你打趴在地上。”

楚南一声冷喝，全身灵气，疯狂运转。
他的右拳，散发出了光芒。
还未出拳，四周就隐约有猛虎在咆哮！
“一出手就是猛虎拳！看来楚南，是没有打算留手啊。”
“当着那么多人的面，被楚弛这个废物打了一巴掌，是我，我也不会留手。”
“没悬念了！”
楚枫等人纷纷摇头。
虽然这一次楚南的拳头，没有击向楚弛的脑袋。
但楚弛就算不死，也要断好几根骨头。
“五哥，你居然用猛虎拳，爷爷昨天不是传过话，让你手下留情吗？七哥，别打了，你不是对手的，快跑啊！”
楚弛旁边，楚盈盈都快急哭了。
她很想帮楚弛，但她也只是凡人境三层的修为，根本帮不上忙。
她的话刚刚落下，楚弛也举起了拳头。
一拳起，猛虎怒吼！
整个院子，能清楚听见猛虎的叫声。
似乎有人在院子里，养了一头老虎！
这虎啸声，不仅杂院能听见。
就连主院和附近的小院，也有人听见了。
“好雄浑的虎啸声？但我楚家，没有人养虎啊。”
“难道，是猛虎拳！如此大的声音，有人将猛虎拳大成了！”

“快，去看看！”
楚弛一举拳，全场皆震！
因为楚弛这一拳的力量，明显要比楚南强大许多。
那一声虎啸，犹如猛虎就在身边。
无论是威压，还是气势，都不是楚南能比不的。
“楚弛，什么时候学的猛虎拳！”
“是啊，气势还这么强！我都做不到。”
惊讶间，两拳相碰！
伴随轰的一声闷响。
空中，有鲜血飘洒。
随后便是刺耳的惨叫声。
“啊！”
发出惨叫的，自然是楚南。
他的右手，从手肘位置，脱臼了！
骨头错位，扎破皮肤。
鲜血喷洒，血肉狰狞！
这一幕，让全场鸦雀无声。
所有人都瞪大了双眼，似乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。
只有楚南的惨叫，还在四周飘荡。
好一会，楚枫率先反应过来。

“楚弛施展的的确是猛虎拳。但如此声势，我只在爷爷在那里见过！这是猛虎拳，大成了！”
“什么？猛虎拳大成，这怎么可能！”
在楚枫等人惊愕的时候，楚弛一步步走向了楚南。
他的拳头，依旧释放出了光芒。
一拳出，猛虎咆哮！
这一拳，击向了楚南的腿。
只听咔擦一声闷响。
楚南的腿，也被楚弛打断了。
猛虎拳大成，他就算运集全身灵气去抵挡，也根本挡不了。
打断手脚后，楚弛将楚南提起，一步步走向了旁边的茅房。
“楚弛，你要干什么？”
楚枫忍不住开口询问。
楚弛根本没有回答，去到茅房后面的粪池，随手一扔！
只听噗嗤一声响。
Shi花四溅。
只是听声音，楚枫等人似乎都闻到了臭味。
楚弛居然，将楚南扔进了粪池！
楚南进入粪池后，明显有些慌。
那恶心的味道，让他忍不住张嘴。
但张嘴，又更恶心了。

他好不容易，忍住伤痛，从粪池里跳了出来。
他的身上，肮脏不堪！
还有虫子，在上面蠕动。
这姿态，大姐楚青荷只是看了一眼，就觉得胃里一震翻涌。
此刻的楚南，更是羞愧难当，恨不得打个地洞钻进去。
太屈辱了。
但还好，现场没有几个人！
这个想法刚落，院子外面，忽然传来了人语。
“刚才的虎啸声，就是这里，没错了！”
“看来大家都被虎啸声吸引来了啊？”
“是谁？是谁将猛虎拳大成了？我楚家，出现了天才吗？”
声音还在飘荡。
楚家的诸位长辈鱼贯而入。
一进来，他们就看见了院子里，全身肮脏的楚南。
content_en:
The night passed quickly, and the sun rose the next day.
Chu Chi rushed to the courtyard where Chu Nan was as promised.
Before he entered the courtyard, he saw Chu Yingying at the door of the courtyard.
Chu Yingying saw Chu Chi and ran over quickly, with a worried look on her face.
"Seventh brother, why are you really here! Go back quickly, you are no match for fifth brother. If you fight with him, your hands and feet will definitely be broken. This time, fifth brother will not show mercy."
"Bamei, are you waiting for me here specifically? But don't worry, nothing will happen to me."
Chu Chi smiled faintly and walked straight to the courtyard gate.
"Brother Seven! You..."
Chu Yingying bit her lip and wanted to stop Chu Chi, but found that Chu Chi's body was like a mountain, unable to stop her at all.
Soon, Chu Chi entered the side courtyard.
In the courtyard, there were not only Chu Nan, but also two women and two young men.
They are Chu Feng, the second-ranked member of the Chu family, Chu Liwen, the fourth-ranked member, and the eldest granddaughter, Chu Qinghe.
These people were obviously here to watch the fun.
Except for these juniors, no elders came to watch the game.
Because none of the elders felt that there was any suspense in this battle. This battle did not interest them.
"Chu Chi, you're actually here! I bet you wouldn't dare to come."
When Chu Feng saw Chu Chi, he frowned.
Chu Chi asked, "Why don't I dare to come?"
"You have a really tough mouth. Ever since you were a child, you have always said the toughest words and received the harshest beatings."
"Chu Chi, after being beaten this time, you won't go back crying and ask your brother to help you, right?"
Chu Liwen and Chu Feng mocked Chu Chi.
Even Chu Qingheye looked contemptuous. He said to Chu Nan: "Fifth brother, we all saw the slap he gave you when he sneaked up on you yesterday. Don't show mercy, you must beat him until you don't even recognize his mother! Oh, I forgot, he has never had a mother since he was a child!"
"Sister, don't worry. How easy is it to get him? Just wait for me for ten breaths. I'll come as soon as I go!"
Chu Nan stood up and walked towards Chu Chi in the center of the yard.
He held his head high, as if he was confident.
"Brother Qi, it's still too late to leave now!"
Chu Yingying stood beside Chu Chi and pulled the corner of Chu Chi's clothes.
Chu Chi smiled slightly and said: "Don't worry, I'm fine. Moreover, this fight must be fought! Why did he bully me before? I want him to return his capital and profits!"
Chu Chi remembered clearly that when he was a child, his brother was not at home and Chu Nan always came to trouble him.
There are always people in this world who like to bully the weak!
Not only did he spit on Chu Chi, but once he took advantage of Chu Chi's unpreparedness and pushed Chu Chi into the manure pit.
Chu Chi has never forgotten that feeling.
In the past, he had no ability and could not fight back if he wanted to.
But now, he has the ability.
He must let Chu Nan come back.
While thinking, Chu Nan came to the opposite side of him, his eyes were arrogant and condescending.
"Chu Chi, I have to say that you are smarter than when you were a child. When you were a child, you would hide when you saw me and didn't dare to look directly at me.
I really didn't expect that you, a loser, could also become a cultivator. But you seem a little arrogant, and you actually dare to challenge me! Then I'll let you know why the flowers are so red! "
Chu Chi said with a cold face: "You talk too much. If you want to fight, then fight."
"Haha, if you want to die early, I will make it happen for you. Watch me punch you and knock you to the ground."
Chu Nan shouted coldly, and his whole body's spiritual energy began to circulate crazily.
His right fist radiated light.
Before he even punches, there are tigers roaring around him!
"The first move was the Tiger Fist! It seems that Chu Nan has no intention of holding back."
"In front of so many people, I was slapped by Chu Chi, a loser, and I won't hold back."
"No more suspense!"
Chu Feng and others shook their heads.
Although this time Chu Nan’s fist did notHit Chu Chi's head.
But even if Chu Chi doesn't die, he still has to break several bones.
"Fifth Brother, you actually used the Tiger Fist. Didn't Grandpa send a message yesterday asking you to show mercy? Seventh Brother, stop fighting. You are no match for me. Run away!"
Next to Chu Chi, Chu Yingying was almost crying.
She wanted to help Chu Chi, but she was only at the third level of the mortal realm and couldn't help at all.
As soon as she finished speaking, Chu Chi also raised his fist.
With one punch, the tiger roared!
The roar of the tiger can be clearly heard throughout the yard.
It seems that someone has a tiger in the yard!
This tiger roar can be heard not only in the courtyard.
Even in the main courtyard and nearby small courtyards, some people heard it.
"What a powerful tiger roar? But no one in my Chu family raises tigers."
"Could it be the Tiger Fist! With such a loud sound, someone made the Tiger Fist into a big one!"
"Quick, go take a look!"
Chu Chi raised his fist and the whole audience was shocked!
Because the power of Chu Chi's punch was obviously much stronger than that of Chu Nan.
That roar of a tiger is like a tiger right next to you.
Whether it's pressure or momentum, Chu Nan can't match it.
"Chu Chi, when did you learn the Tiger Fist!"
"Yeah, the momentum is so strong! I can't even do it."
In surprise, the two fists collided!
Accompanied by a muffled sound.
There was blood flying in the air.
Then came the ear-piercing screams.
"Ah!"
The one who screamed was naturally Chu Nan.
His right hand was dislocated from the elbow!
Bones misaligned and skin punctured.
Blood sprays, flesh and blood is ferocious!
This scene left the entire audience silent.
Everyone's eyes widened, as if they couldn't believe their eyes.
Only Chu Nan's screams were still floating around.
After a while, Chu Feng was the first to react.
"What Chu Chi performed was indeed the Tiger Fist. But with such force, I have only seen it in my grandpa's place! This is the Tiger Fist, a great success!"
"What? Tiger Fist Mastery, how is this possible!"
While Chu Feng and others were astonished, Chu Chi walked towards Chu Nan step by step.
His fist still released light.
With one punch, the tiger roars!
This punch hit Chu Nan's leg.
Just heard a muffled click.
Chu Nan's legs were also broken by Chu Chi.
With the mastery of the Tiger Fist, even if he gathered all his spiritual energy to resist, he would not be able to stop it at all.
After breaking his hands and feet, Chu Chi lifted Chu Nan up and walked step by step to the latrine next to him.
"Chu Chi, what do you want to do?"
Chu Feng couldn't help but ask.
Chu Chi didn't answer at all. He went to the cesspit behind the hut and threw it away!
Just hear a popping sound.
Rocks and flowers splashed everywhere.
Just listening to the sound, Chu Feng and others seemed to smell the stench.
Chu Chi actually threw Chu Nan into the cesspool!
After Chu Nan entered the manure tank, he was obviously panicked.
The disgusting taste made him unable to help but open his mouth.
But when I opened my mouth, it became even more disgusting.
With great difficulty, he endured the pain and jumped out of the cesspool.
His body was filthy!
There are also bugs crawling on it.
The eldest sister, Chu Qinghe, just took one look at this gesture and felt her stomach churn.
At this moment, Chu Nan was even more ashamed and wished he could dig a hole in the ground and crawl in.
So humiliating.
But fortunately, there were not many people there!
As soon as this thought came to an end, voices suddenly came from outside the courtyard.
"The roar of the tiger just now was right here, that's right!"
"It seems that everyone is attracted by the roar of the tiger?"
"Who is it? Who mastered the Tiger Fist? Is there a genius in our Chu family?"
The sound is still floating.
The elders of the Chu family filed in.
As soon as they entered, they saw Chu Nan in the yard, who was all dirty.
